text:
You will come all the same. Why not now?

How long I have waited. Hard times are coming.

I have put out the light and opened the door

for you, because you are magical and simple.

Take, then, whatever form pleases you most,

aim and fire a poisoned bullet at me,

or strangle me like an efficient murderer,

or infect me—the typhus would be my lot—,

or burst from the fairy tale you wrote,

the one we are tired of hearing day and night,

in which blue guards climb the stairs,

led by the caretaker, pale with fear.

It is all the same to me. The Yenisei swirls,

the North Star twinkles as it always will,

and the blue glint in my beloved's eyes

is darkened by the final horror.

translation.title: To Death
translation.editorial_note: Translated from the supplied Spanish rendering rather than directly from the Russian original; the intimate address to Death, the fairy-tale intrusion, and the final celestial imagery are retained.
